raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

**What goes wrong**
Wan VAE decode on ROCm fails with `TypeError: RocmPlatform._replace_conv3d_with_conv2d.<locals>._patched_forward() got an unexpected keyword argument 'residual'`. #38650 made the Wan VAE decoder call `WanCausalConv3d` with `residual=` and `skip_bias=` (the fused conv-bias epilogue). The ROCm Conv3d-to-Conv2d replacement installs its own `forward` that only takes `(x, cache_x)`, so the decoder's first patched conv call raises.

**Where it shows up**
Any ROCm device that enables the patch (`SGLANG_USE_ROCM_VAE_CONV2D=1` or `SGLANG_USE_ROCM_VAE_CONV2D_BF16=1`) and decodes with the Wan VAE through the non-fused cache path. Reproduced with Wan2.2-T2V-A14B on gfx1250: denoising completes, then DecodingStage fails.

**How to fix**
Accept `residual` and `skip_bias` in the patched forward with the same contract as `WanCausalConv3d.forward`: drop the bias when `skip_bias` is set, add `residual` to the conv output.

## Modifications

- `runtime/platforms/rocm.py`: `_patched_forward` takes `residual=None, skip_bias=False`, passes `None` as bias when `skip_bias`, and adds `residual` to the output.
- `test/unit/test_rocm_conv3d_patch.py`: regression test that the patched conv matches the original `WanCausalConv3d` with `residual` and with `skip_bias`. It fails on the pre-fix code with the same `TypeError` and passes with the fix.

## Accuracy Tests

| Check | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Patched vs original conv, fp32 (residual / skip_bias) | `TypeError` | max abs diff 1.9e-6 |
| Patched vs original conv, BF16 compute, channels_last_3d (96ch, 90x160) | `TypeError` | rel. error 0.17% to 0.34%, no NaN |
| Wan2.2-T2V-A14B 1280x720, 33 frames, gfx1250 | DecodingStage `TypeError` | decodes; correct content across frames |

Long-video (193-frame) validation is still in progress and will be added.

## Benchmarking and Profiling

| Config | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Wan2.2-T2V-A14B, 1280x720x193f, VAE decode | crash | 119.6 s |

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the PR flow. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`, `/tag-and-rerun-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls to merge.

                 x = x.to(self.weight.dtype)
-                return RocmPlatform._conv3d_as_batched_conv2d(
+                # Same contract as WanCausalConv3d.forward: skip_bias leaves the bias
+                # to a following fused norm, residual is added to the conv output.

                     x,

-                    self.bias,
+                    None if skip_bias else self.bias,

                     compute_bf16=_bf16,

+                return out if residual is None else out + residual

@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.vaes.wanvae import WanCausalConv3d
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.platforms.rocm import RocmPlatform
+
+
+class TestRocmConv3dPatchEpilogueKwargs(unittest.TestCase):
+    """The Wan VAE decoder calls its causal convs with residual= and skip_bias=;
+    the ROCm Conv3d->Conv2d replacement must accept them and match the original."""
+
+    def test_patched_conv_matches_original_with_residual_and_skip_bias(self):
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+        ref = WanCausalConv3d(8, 16, 3, padding=1)
+        patched = WanCausalConv3d(8, 16, 3, padding=1)
+        patched.load_state_dict(ref.state_dict())
+        self.assertEqual(RocmPlatform._replace_conv3d_with_conv2d(patched), 1)
+
+        x = torch.randn(1, 8, 3, 12, 12)
+        cache_x = torch.randn(1, 8, 2, 12, 12)
+        residual = torch.randn(1, 16, 3, 12, 12)
+        for kwargs in ({"residual": residual}, {"skip_bias": True}):
+            with self.subTest(kwargs=list(kwargs)), torch.no_grad():
+                torch.testing.assert_close(
+                    patched(x, cache_x, **kwargs), ref(x, cache_x, **kwargs)
+                )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
